notes: DeepFlux 8.0 - the agent learns to grab videos. Two new agent tools: scan_video_page sees every stream a video page embeds (recommended stream with quality renditions, ranked alternates) and download_video downloads from any page, stream or YouTube link in one confirmed step - with the Referer context hotlink CDNs require and a max_height quality cap. YouTube links route through yt-dlp instead of saving the HTML page, and the app no longer jumps between tabs on its own while the agent works (downloads and navigation stay where you are looking).
